nodes.name: Canvas Design System
nodes.summary: Visual design philosophy, systematic composition, and sophisticated visual communication for canvas-based designs. Covers design philosophy creation, visual expression, core principles, and implementation guidelines.

nodes.name: shadcn/ui Accessibility Patterns
nodes.summary: ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and accessible component usage for shadcn/ui built on Radix UI primitives. Covers focus management, form accessibility, and testing checklists.

nodes.name: shadcn/ui Component Reference
nodes.summary: Complete catalog of shadcn/ui components with usage patterns and installation. Covers form inputs, layout/navigation, overlays/dialogs, feedback/status, and display components.

nodes.name: shadcn/ui Theming & Customization
nodes.summary: Theme configuration, CSS variables, dark mode, and component customization for shadcn/ui. Covers dark mode setup, CSS variable system, color customization, and component variants.

nodes.name: Tailwind CSS Customization
nodes.summary: Config file structure, custom utilities, plugins, and theme extensions for Tailwind CSS v4. Covers @theme directive, color/typography/spacing customization, custom utilities, and plugins.

nodes.name: Tailwind CSS Responsive Design
nodes.summary: Mobile-first breakpoints, responsive utilities, and adaptive layouts for Tailwind CSS. Covers breakpoint system, responsive patterns, container queries, and testing checklists.

nodes.name: Tailwind CSS Utility Reference
nodes.summary: Core utility classes for layout, spacing, typography, colors, borders, and shadows in Tailwind CSS. Comprehensive reference for display, flexbox, grid, spacing, and visual utilities.
